content: GitHub Pages cannot set custom COOP/COEP headers. DuckDB-Wasm threaded/EH builds needing SharedArrayBuffer require cross-origin isolation. Workaround: coi-serviceworker (patches headers via a Service Worker on first load, causing one reload). Alternative: use the MVP (single-threaded) DuckDB-Wasm bundle which does not require SharedArrayBuffer/cross-origin isolation at all.
